actions.action: Stop watering until top 2-3 cm is dry and meter drops
Remove plant from cachepot so water can't pool
Check drainage holes in inner pot
If plant keeps declining, slide it out and inspect roots
If roots are rotten, trim them and repot in fresh faster-draining mix
Cross-check meter by pushing chopstick or finger into soil
If roots healthy but soil drains slowly, switch to chunkier mix with more bark

reason: The answer treats wet soil and root rot as the main cause and lists repotting stress only third, never mentioning low light; its advice to stop watering and keep the plant in place leaves out the extra sun or grow light that fixed it, though it isn't actively harmful.
